title: The Chagga People of Kilimanjaro
excerpt: The Chagga have lived on the slopes of Kilimanjaro for centuries, farming bananas and coffee with clever irrigation.
body:
## Who are the Chagga?

The Chagga are one of Tanzania's larger ethnic groups. They live on the southern and eastern slopes of Kilimanjaro, around Moshi and Marangu.

## Farming

They farm in "home gardens" with bananas, coffee, beans and vegetables, using traditional irrigation channels that bring water from the mountain.

## Coffee

Coffee became an important cash crop in the 20th century. See [Tanzanian coffee](/blog/tanzanian-coffee/).

## Underground caves

In some places you can visit tunnels that, according to local history, were used for hiding during conflicts.

## Banana beer

Mbege is a traditional beer brewed from bananas and millet.

## Visit

A village walk in Marangu or [Materuni](/blog/materuni-waterfall-coffee-tour/) is a great way to learn more.
